Stage 1 — Logo Review

You're helping choose the visual direction of the brand. Enter your name to begin voting.

Before you vote — please read

These are not final logos. Every mark here is a Stage 1 mockup — a rough directional sketch. The winners will be refined, revamped, and professionally improved before anything ships.

This review exists to figure out which visual path our brand should run with — shapes, energy, and style — not to pick a finished logo.

How voting works:

  • Rate each logo 1–5 stars (tap the same star again to clear).
  • Logos you skip are recorded as N/A — no pressure to rate everything.
  • Tap a star a second time on the same value to undo it.
  • When done, hit Submit Vote. You'll be asked a couple of quick questions about your top picks, then your ballot is locked in.
  • One ballot per person. Your votes go only to the admin — no one else sees them.
